head: """Capability-based browser automation for Tool Ecosystem v2.
This provider is intentionally separate from ``computer_use.browser_cdp``.
The historical adapter accepts arbitrary selectors and JavaScript; neither is
part of this surface.  Browser v2 connects only to one explicitly configured
loopback CDP endpoint and attests the browser's exact ``--user-data-dir`` and
debugging port before every operation.
Reads use the Chrome DevTools Accessibility domain.  Actions accept only a
short-lived, single-use element capability minted after an exact accessible
role/name query produced one complete match.  The strict locator is resolved
once to a stable Playwright element handle; page, loader and AX backend node
identity are then revalidated before that same handle is used.  No ``.first``,
coordinates, synthesized keys or caller-provided selectors are accepted.
Generic activation remains inconclusive after an independent page readback:
a click can purchase, submit, delete or navigate and no generic observation
proves the user's intended postcondition.  Value changes require an
independent fresh CDP connection and exact value readback.  Both operations
are HIGH risk and therefore require the v2 policy confirmation boundary.
The production adapter opens and closes a new Playwright CDP connection per
handler/verifier call.  This avoids sharing Playwright's thread-affine sync API
between Invoker workers and makes verifier observations independent.
